conventions.testing: Unit tests in src/ and tests/ directories; integration tests in tests/; uses #[cfg(test)] modules
conventions.linting: clippy with deny-level lints (undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used); rustfmt; deny.toml for dependency checks
conventions.error_handling: Result types with thiserror; Option for nullable values; must_use attributes

patterns: Language registration pattern: mod.rs get_language_info() match arm + get_ts_language() match arm
Query constants: ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY as pub const &str
Handler pattern: extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, extract_inheritance as pub fn
constraints: DEFUSE_QUERY is mandatory per LanguageInfo struct
No feature flags for language dependencies
test_coverage: Existing language tests in java.rs cover element_query, extract_inheritance, and defuse_query. Pattern: parse source, find node via stack traversal, call handler, assert results.

library_findings.notes: alex-pinkus/tree-sitter-swift; dev-only dependency on tree-sitter; uses tree-sitter-language ^0.1.0
Workspace dependency; tree-sitter-swift has no runtime conflict

approaches.name: Follow Java pattern (recommended)
approaches.description: Create swift.rs modeling java.rs structure: ELEMENT_QUERY for function/class/protocol declarations, DEFUSE_QUERY for local vars/assignments/reads, extract_inheritance walking inheritance_specifier. Wire via mod.rs match arms.

approaches.name: Minimal stub approach
approaches.description: Add swift.rs with only ELEMENT_QUERY and DEFUSE_QUERY, skip handlers. Register in mod.rs.

approaches.name: Full handler approach
approaches.description: Implement all handlers including extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, extract_inheritance with Swift-specific logic.

recommendation: Follow Java pattern (recommended) - balances speed and completeness. Swift's inheritance syntax is simpler than Java's (no extends/implements distinction), making extract_inheritance straightforward.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
inheritance_walk_citation: Per tree-sitter-swift grammar.js/node-types.json: Walk class_declaration's _inheritance_specifiers children. For each inheritance_specifier, read the inherits_from field which points to a user_type node; extract the type_identifier text from user_type. Multiple specifiers appear as comma-separated siblings.
